narrative.overview: The current approved direction is a compact Apple TV–inspired Scenic dock. Wallpaper leads the upper screen and darkens toward the bottom behind viewing content and apps. V2 contains this single layout, with large time/date and no visible Overlook branding. V1 remains classic and unchanged by this design revision.
keyCharacteristics: Scenic wallpaper with a bottom-darkening veil.
Compact artwork cards and centered app tiles.
Large time/date and explicit remote focus.
dos: Do preserve the time/date and bottom-darkened scenic wallpaper.
Do keep card text and remote-focus outlines readable and unclipped.
Do use real provider content and owning-app fallback icons.
donts: Don't add visible Overlook branding to v2 home.
Don't restore the removed cinematic hero or artwork-first layout.
Don't invent viewing history for providers without readable entries.
